description: Source code implementing SIMD-accelerated convolution functions for image processing, specifically using SSE2 instructions for horizontal and vertical convolution in the skia graphics library.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally_SSE2
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single row using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: Convolve4RowsHorizontally_SSE2
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on four rows simultaneously using SSE2 instructions.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically_SSE2
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution on image data using SSE2 instructions, with template specialization for alpha channel handling.
